hints: Build one side and one corner first, then press Run. If the robot drives forward and makes a quarter turn, the hard part is done.
A side is five lines: both wheels 0.6, sleep 1000, both wheels 0. A corner is the same shape with leftDrive at -0.5, rightDrive at 0.5 and sleep 785.

Select the eleven lines of one side and one corner, copy them, and paste three more times. Then sign it: telemetry.addData("Pilot", "Sam"); with your name in the quote marks, and telemetry.update(); after it.
